about_the_game:
Arcadia: Cloudbound is a unique 3D spot-the-difference game that challenges players to explore and appreciate stunning 360° rotating models while uncovering subtle variations hidden within each scene. In every level, you’ll scrutinize intricately designed 3D models to find five distinct differences—ranging from obvious discrepancies to cleverly concealed details.

Key Features:

Artistic and Visual Experience:

Every element in Arcadia—from its crafted 3D models and richly detailed scenes to its sophisticated UI and atmospheric music—is designed to deliver a premium artistic experience. This commitment to art makes Arcadia one of the most visually impressive spot-the-difference games on the market.

360° Gameplay:

Rotate and examine models from every angle, discovering differences that reward both careful observation and an appreciation of exquisite design.

Rich Gameplay Variety:

Beyond the standard spot-the-difference challenges, Arcadia offers over 10 engaging mini-games. Some differences require you to solve puzzles, adding an extra layer of interactivity and fun.

Diverse and Expansive Environments:

With over 50 uniquely themed scenes—and plans to expand to 100 scenes and 20 mini-games within six months—players are treated to a continually evolving array of breathtaking environments.

Multiplayer and Ranking Systems:

15 players in real-time online battles, and enjoy specialized two-player ranking modes to compete with friends. An integrated ranking system rewards skill and progression.

Innovative Collection and Building Mechanics:

Earn stars in every level to contribute to an in-game house building system, and unlock a collection of 10 exclusive 3D figurine models through hidden Easter eggs.

Brain-Enhancing Level Design:

In collaboration with UMass Brain Development Department, our levels are designed to not only entertain but also stimulate cognitive skills, offering a beneficial mental workout.

Universal Appeal:

Featuring moderate difficulty suitable for all ages and supporting the top 10 global languages, Arcadia ensures an accessible and inclusive experience for players around the world.
